text:
Eve (AE): Heads-up — SylvanHealth POC advancing to procurement. They require separate PO numbers + invoices for SylvanHealth US, SylvanHealth EU (IE), and SylvanHealth Labs UK. Procurement also sent a DPA redline asking for: HSM for hosted, 48h incident notification, and e-sign envelope chain-of-custody language. Can we accommodate multi-entity PDF invoices and delegated AP signers?

procurement_sylvan: Hi team — AP can sign order forms. Need invoice per legal entity (separate PDF), VAT reverse-charge for EU, and confirmation whether you accept delegated signers. Also flagged HSM requirement for hosted.

Tom (Legal): Delegated AP signers OK with a short attestation: name, title, email, and statement they can bind the entity. HSM for hosted is an escalation — standard practice: HSM only for Private/Dedicated. For Hosted we can offer KMS attestation + SOC2 report. 48h notification is aggressive; propose "reasonable efforts" + 72h confirmation window after incident validation. Also the DPA's 30-day deletion demand conflicts with infra backups; we'll counter with 90-day retention + documented purge steps.

Zoe (Solutions Eng): On the OF/invoice mapping we can support per-entity metadata and wire separate invoices. Sample OF payload we propose: ```billing_entity: sylvan-eu-ltd
po_number: SH-EU-2026-03
vat_number: IE987654321
signer: "AP Team <ap@sylvanhealth.eu>"
``` Fallback: if signer missing, route to parent-account finance alias. For e-sign: we support DocuSign-style envelopes and can capture signer email/role in metadata to ensure binding.

Pri (Finance): Separate PDFs per legal entity are required for tax/reporting. Need tax IDs and remit addresses before first invoice. For EU reverse-charge, we need validated VAT numbers. Net terms: procurement requested net30; finance can approve pending credit check. If credit check fails, we require prepay for POC.

Nikhil (Security): HSM ask: hosted gets attestable KMS and pen-test/SOC2 artifacts; we don't provide dedicated HSMs for hosted customers by default. If customer insists on HSM custody for hosted, that's a product exception and will affect timeline and cost. For envelope chain-of-custody, we can provide audit logs showing sign times and IPs; we don't currently provide notarized chain-of-custody but can discuss escrow or additional attestations for enterprise deals. Also we do not support key export for hosted KMS.

esign-bot: DocuSign event: envelope SH-PO-2026-03 failed to auto-route for signer ap@sylvanhealth.eu — manual retry pending.

Eve (AE): Procurement — can you confirm AP signer emails + remit addresses and send the redlined DPA? Also tell us if separate legal countersigners are required or AP delegates sufficient.

procurement_sylvan: We'll send redlines and remit/VAT IDs today. AP delegation ok, we'll include attestation. One more ask: liability cap = 12 months fees — acceptable?

Tom (Legal): We'll counter with liability cap = fees paid in prior 12 months or $250k floor, whichever is greater. We'll draft an attestation clause for AP signers and push back on HSM-for-hosted language.

Pri (Finance): Confirming workflow: one invoice PDF per entity, unique invoice numbers, separate remit-to, VAT handling per entity. Provide PO->entity mapping before first invoice.

Zoe (Solutions Eng): I'll prepare a sample OF JSON and an e-sign checklist (fields required for signer mapping) and post here. Include fields: billing_entity_id, signer_email, signer_role, po_number, remit_to_id.

Eve (AE): Thanks everyone — I'll collect redline + VAT/tax info from procurement and post back. Will also follow up on the DocuSign envelope failure and retry. :white_check_mark:
